mapper.sql: p.id, p.user_id, p.body, p.edited_at, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.username AS author_username, u.name AS author_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.id) AS like_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS comment_count, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.id AND l.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS liked_by_me
mapper.select: SELECT FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.id = #{postId}
